name: dictionary-ollama-format
description: ollama v0.5.0 changed api.GenerateRequest.Format from string to json.RawMessage, so the literal Format: "json" in cmd/translate/main.go no longer compiles. The repository has no tests. The one-line repair has a trap: json.RawMessage("json") compiles but is not valid JSON and fails when the request is marshalled; the correct value is the JSON string, json.RawMessage(`"json"`).
